source.source_name: YouTube, Gogumafarm, Careet, Naver SNS/content trend crawl

curation.selection_policy: Platform-level cleaned candidates and keyword terms were prepared from crawled trend data. Null values, duplicates, and unnecessary columns were removed where applicable.

preprocessing_steps: merge candidates from youtube, gogumafarm, careet, and naver
match query terms against candidate titles, contexts, and metadata
rank candidates by query relevance and recency
export flat CSV result for Airflow-friendly validation

query_ranked_candidates.query: 니가 좋아 밈을 활용한 여름 카페 신메뉴 숏폼 광고

limitations: This artifact is generated from a single demo query, so it is not a full global trend ranking dataset.
Only the top ranked candidates for the query are included.
Instagram data is not included because collection was blocked by policy or access limitations.
Some source URLs or platform-specific metadata may be empty depending on the source.
next_version_plan: Create a broader weekly sns_trend release with stable platform schema, full global ranking, and optional query-specific ranked candidate exports.
